outline.subject: The New South Wales C38 class is a series of steam locomotives built for express passenger services in Australia.

sections.title: New South Wales C38 class locomotive
sections.covers: This section introduces the C38 class locomotives and their role in hauling express passenger services.

sections.title: Design
sections.covers: This section details the development and engineering specifications of the locomotive class.

sections.title: History
sections.covers: This section covers the construction, operational history, and eventual withdrawal of the locomotives.

sections.title: Preservation
sections.covers: This section describes the survival and storage of the remaining locomotives.
